name: NLA.SP15.finite_fiber_selection
header:
theorem finite_fiber_selection (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ x : Fin (M + 1) → Parameters, Function.Injective x ∧
      (∀ i, x i ∈ parameterBox) ∧ (∀ i, coefficients (x i) = coefficientBaseValue)

name: NLA.SP15.arbitrary_finite_counterfamilies
header:
theorem arbitrary_finite_counterfamilies (M : ℕ) :
    ∃ A : Fin (M + 1) → Square 9,
      (∀ i j, SuperIdentical (A i) (A j)) ∧
      ∀ i j : Fin (M + 1), i < j → ¬ UnitarySimilar (A i) (A j)
